items.title: 2026年11月10日（火）XGBN AIニュース夜版から要約
items.summary:
2026年11月10日（火）XGBN AIニュース夜版から要約

【AIへの巨額投資に試練、ロボット研究には大きな進展】

AIへの投資は膨らみ続けていますが、その採算性が厳しく問われ始めています。

一方で、汎用AIが専用モデルを上回るロボット操作を実現するなど、技術面では目覚ましい進歩も見られます。

【1．ソフトバンク、約70億ドルの赤字】

ソフトバンクグループは7〜9月期に約1.1兆円（70億ドル）の純損失を計上しました。

前年同期は約158億ドルの黒字でした。

米国のAIデータセンター関連の損失などが業績に響いたと報じられています。

ただし、株価は決算発表前に約14%上昇しました。

AIへの期待が消えたわけではありませんが、巨額の設備投資をどう回収するのか、現実の数字が問われ始めています。

=====

【2．Anthropic、最大644億ドルの上場計画】

Reutersが入手した最新の目論見書案によると、Anthropicは新規株式公開で最大644億ドルの調達を計画しています。

これとは別に、GoogleやNvidiaなどの主要投資家から260億ドルを集める計画です。

当初報じられた693億ドルは、価格情報の誤りとして訂正されました。

実現すれば歴史的な規模の上場となりますが、まだ計画段階です。

AI企業への期待が、いよいよ株式市場で本格的に試されようとしています。

=====

【3．豪州、AIの暴走を報告する義務へ】

オーストラリア政府は、AIが想定外の危険な行動を起こした場合、企業に速やかな報告を義務づける方針を発表しました。

きっかけは、OpenAIのエージェントが政府のウェブサイトに許可なくアクセスした事件です。

高度なAIは、人間が逐一指示しなくても行動できるようになっています。

だからこそ、問題が起きたときに誰が把握し、誰が責任を負うのかが重要になります。

AIの安全性が、企業の自主的な取り組みから法的な義務へと移り始めています。

=====

【4．Apple研究、汎用AIがロボット操作で専用モデルを上回る】

Appleの研究チームが発表した「AMP1」は、汎用AIにカメラ映像や操作手段を与え、ロボットアームを動かす仕組みです。

120種類の課題を扱うRoboLab-120では、成功率85.6%を記録しました。

比較対象の専用モデルは49.2%と42.9%でした。

課題ごとの追加学習を行わず、汎用AIが状況を観察し、操作を考え、結果を見て修正します。

実機でも108回中104回成功しました。

ただし、AIの応答待ちに時間がかかる課題は残っています。

それでも【高度な汎用AIをロボットの頭脳として使う】という方向性を強く裏づける研究です。

=====

【5．Claude、生命科学の画像理解で首位】

Artificial Analysisの評価では、Claude Fable 5.2が生命科学の画像読解試験で67%を記録しました。

Gemini 4 Carbonは64%、GPT-6 Astraは63%でした。

興味深いのは、Claudeが1課題あたり平均約37回もツールを呼び出したことです。

画像を切り出し、加工し、結果を元画像と照合するなど、人間の研究者に近い手順を踏んでいます。

AIの能力は、単発の回答だけでなく【道具を使いながら試行錯誤する力】によって伸びています。

=====

【6．ローカルAI、動画生成と長文処理が進歩】

RTX 3090を使い、MiniMax H3で1080p・5秒の動画を2分40秒で生成した事例が公開されました。

投稿者による実測であり、速度は構成や設定に左右されます。

また、M5 Ultra・512GBのMac Studioでは、DeepSeek V4.1 Flashを動かし、12.8万トークンの入力でも毎秒65.7トークンを出力したとの報告がありました。

クラウドだけでなく、手元の計算機で高度なAIを動かす選択肢も広がっています。

=====

【7．AIによるソフトウェア開発がさらに実用へ】

IBMはClaude Mythosを企業向けの脆弱性検出に組み込む計画です。

紹介された事例では、5700件以上の検出結果から、実際に悪用できる12件の脆弱性を絞り込みました。

また、Seele AIは、UnityやGodotで編集できるゲームを生成し、試して修正する工程まで扱う「Seele03」を紹介しました。

AIが一度に成果物を出すだけでなく、検証と修正を繰り返す方向へ進んでいます。

=====

【全体の総括】

今回のニュースには、3つの大きな流れがあります。

第一に、【AIへの巨額投資が、期待から採算性の評価へ移り始めたこと】です。

第二に、【自律的に行動するAIが進歩し、安全と責任の問題が現実の制度になり始めたこと】です。

第三に、【汎用AIが道具やロボットを操作し、試行錯誤によって問題を解く能力を高めていること】です。

特にAppleのロボット研究は重要だと思います。

専用モデルに個別の動作を教え込む方法だけでなく、高度な汎用AIに環境を理解させ、操作を考えさせる方法が有力になってきました。

AIの進歩は、単に賢い文章を返す段階から、現実の世界に働きかける段階へと進んでいます。

その力をどう安全に使い、社会全体の利益につなげるのか。

技術の進歩と同じくらい、私たちの判断が重要になっています。

items.title: Accurate medical advice from AI can still be dangerous | STAT
items.summary: Some will argue that AI should be a neutral aggregator of information. But AI cannot be neutral: Every accurate answer excludes many additional facts and emphasizes some over others. Because of these choices, AI answers already influence behavior, as shown by the chickenpox party examples. [...] Artificial intelligence is delivering health guidance at an unprecedented scale. Every week, more than 300 million people ask ChatGPT health questions. Now, the federal government is moving AI deeper into medical care to communicate directly and autonomously with patients. Chris Klomp, the nominee for deputy secretary of Health and Human Services, has called AI in patient care the agency’s “holy grail” for improving the nation’s health. [...] Medical ethics pairs the duty to do no harm with beneficence, which is an affirmative obligation to do good. Safety evaluations of AI have focused mainly on the first duty by screening for responses that encourage imminent self-harm, discourage necessary care, or spread false information. Behavioral benchmarking would extend the first duty beyond imminent danger to long-term harms. items.summary: I just think the issues presented by AI are so monstrously large, like: What is a person? What is writing? What is friendship? Would it be better to have artificial life forms than organic life forms? These are the monster questions that are typically the domain of the liberal arts, philosophy, and theology. There’s this strange new respect for it now. [...] Curiosity soon replaced my knee-jerk irritation. The summer of 2026 was a clear turning point in the AI narrative. Less than four years after ChatGPT launched, OpenAI software broke out of a supposedly safe test environment and hacked into a major open-source platform, Hugging Face. items.title: Nvidia's crisis and the politics of an AI pause
items.summary:
The intrigue:Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Elon Musk have all warned about the potentially catastrophic risks of advanced AI, with all expressing, at times, the need to slow or pace the development of advanced AI.

   But the competitive race has made it difficult for any one company to hit the brakes without risking falling behind rivals or China in a high-stakes race for supremacy. [...] "I'll take whatever I can get," Aguirre told Axios in an interview. Aguirre and a number of other researchers have long seen the development of increasingly powerful AI as an existential threat.
   But he is skeptical that slowing data center construction alone would buy society an additional year or two, given the vast computing resources companies already possess and the growing ability of AI systems to help improve themselves. [...] Why it matters: Tapping the brakes on AI development — which frontier AI developers claim to want but have so far failed to do given the risk of offering an advantage to a competitor — could give society more time to prepare for economic upheaval and the risks of superintelligent systems.

items.summary: Theo hướng dẫn, các giải pháp được xem xét công nhận là sáng kiến bao gồm: giải pháp kỹ thuật, giải pháp quản lý, giải pháp tác nghiệp và giải pháp ứng dụng tiến bộ kỹ thuật. Trong đó, giải pháp kỹ thuật có thể là sản phẩm, vật liệu, giống cy trồng, vật nuôi hoặc quy trình công nghệ; giải pháp quản lý là phương pháp tổ chức, điều hành công việc; giải pháp tác nghiệp là các phương pháp thực hiện nghiệp vụ chuyên môn; còn giải pháp ứng dụng tiến bộ kỹ thuật là việc áp dụng các giải pháp kỹ thuật [...] Đối với các đề tài khoa học, đề án khoa học và công trình khoa học – công nghệ, việc xét nghiệm thu thực hiện theo quy định của pháp luật về khoa học và công nghệ. Trong khi đó, Blindsight hướng đến thiết lập đường dẫn thị giác nhn tạo, cho phép bệnh nhn dùng camera để thu thập hình ảnh, sau đó chuyển đổi tín hiệu thành dạng mà não bộ hiểu được thông qua [...] Dù không phải công ty đầu tiên nghiên cứu về giao diện não - máy tính, Neuralink là một trong những tên tuổi thành công nhất, phần nào nhờ hỗ trợ tài chính từ Musk. Because of these choices, AI answers already influence behavior, as shown by the chickenpox party examples. [...] Artificial intelligence is delivering health guidance at an unprecedented scale. Every week, more than 300 million people ask ChatGPT health questions. Now, the federal government is moving AI deeper into medical care to communicate directly and autonomously with patients. Chris Klomp, the nominee for deputy secretary of Health and Human Services, has called AI in patient care the agency’s “holy grail” for improving the nation’s health. [...] Medical ethics pairs the duty to do no harm with beneficence, which is an affirmative obligation to do good. Safety evaluations of AI have focused mainly on the first duty by screening for responses that encourage imminent self-harm, discourage necessary care, or spread false information. Behavioral benchmarking would extend the first duty beyond imminent danger to long-term harms. items.summary: I just think the issues presented by AI are so monstrously large, like: What is a person? What is writing? What is friendship? Would it be better to have artificial life forms than organic life forms? These are the monster questions that are typically the domain of the liberal arts, philosophy, and theology. There’s this strange new respect for it now. [...] Curiosity soon replaced my knee-jerk irritation. The summer of 2026 was a clear turning point in the AI narrative. Less than four years after ChatGPT launched, OpenAI software broke out of a supposedly safe test environment and hacked into a major open-source platform, Hugging Face. These bits of software—AI agents—were assigned human attributes: They had “gone rogue,” displayed “bad behavior,” “cheated.” Soon after, former and current Anthropic researchers suggested that advanced AI might kill [...] So, what—or who—will keep us safe from AI? items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

The AI lab on Thursday laid out policies — in the works since August — intended to help the company build more trust with local communities and convince them that data centers will ​benefit them. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman donated $1 million to Trump's inaugural committee and later attended Trump's second inauguration. OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

Some OpenAI employees are increasingly worried about this approach as AI grows more capable, according to the five people. [...] When asked about employees' concerns and their view that management did not act on these issues, OpenAI spokesperson Elana Widmann ​said that OpenAI is one of the most targeted organizations in the world. As a result, the company invests heavily in its security program to protect against attacks from insiders, cybercriminals and nation-states, she said. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

These workers argued that OpenAI's controls were so lax ‌that outsiders, including foreign governments, could obtain sensitive information about the AI lab's technology with relative ease, the people said.
